meaning.en: the Blessed One said
with its root above, upward-rooted
with its branches below, downward-branching
the sacred fig tree (ashvattha)
they speak of, they describe
imperishable, undecaying
the Vedic hymns, sacred verses
whose leaves
whoever knows that (tree)
he is the knower of the Vedas

meaning.en: downward and upward, both directions
its branches spread out
nourished and grown by the three gunas
with sense-objects as their tender shoots
and roots below as well
spreading continuously, extending further
binding one to action and its results
in the world of human beings

meaning.en: its true form is not, here in this world
perceived or made out that way
neither end nor beginning
nor any foundation it firmly stands on
this fig tree
whose roots have grown in deep and strong
with the weapon of non-attachment
having cut it down firmly, resolutely

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then that place, that state
is to be sought out, must be searched for
having gone to which
they do not return again
to that very primeval one
I take refuge in, I surrender to
from whom the outward flow (of existence)
originally poured forth, ancient in origin

meaning.en: free of false pride and delusion
having conquered the flaw of attachment
meaning.hi: आसक्ति के दोष को जीत चुके

meaning.en: constantly established in the self
with all desire turned away, fallen away
meaning.hi: जिनकी कामना सर्वथा शांत हो चुकी

meaning.en: freed from the pairs of opposites
known as pleasure and pain
the undeluded ones go
to that imperishable state

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the sun does not light it up
nor the moon
nor fire
having gone to which (place)
they do not return
that is my own supreme abode

meaning.en: a fragment, a portion of my own self
in the world of living beings
becomes the individual living being
eternal, without beginning
the senses, with the mind as the sixth
which are situated in, belong to nature
draws to itself, pulls along

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whatever body he takes on
and whatever (body) he departs from
meaning.hi: और जिससे वह निकल जाता है

meaning.en: the lord (of the body), the soul as master
having taken hold of these (mind and senses)
goes along, carries them off
as the wind carries scents
from their resting place, from where they were seated

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the ear, the eye
and the sense of touch
taste, and smell as well
taking his seat over these, and over the mind too, this (soul)

meaning.en: makes use of, partakes of the sense-objects

or as it remains, stays put
or as it enjoys itself joined with the gunas
meaning.hi: या गुणों सहित भोग करते हुए को

meaning.en: the deluded do not perceive it at all
those with the eye of wisdom do see it

meaning.en: those established in yoga, striving, perceive this (soul)
see it seated within themselves
even those who strive
whose inner self has not been made ready, unprepared within
do not see it
lacking the (right) understanding, unaware

meaning.en: the brightness that is seated in the sun

meaning.en: whatever (light) is in the moon
and whatever is in fire
